title: ProfileExchange
description: Firestore document schema for the `users/{uid}/exchanges` subcollection. The document id is the other attendee's Firebase Auth uid. `origin: 'scan'` documents are created by the owning attendee; `origin: 'mirror'` documents are created by a Cloud Function trigger on the other attendee's behalf.

token.description: Signed exchange token presented on scan. Cleared to null by a Cloud Function once verified, so it never lingers.

note.description: Free-form note visible only to the owner of this subcollection.
